description: Leave applied for by your employees. Approving one spends the employee's balance for that leave type and writes an ON_LEAVE attendance record for each day, so payroll and attendance stay in step with the decision.

empty.pendingDescription: Every leave request has been decided. New ones land here as employees apply from their app.
empty.otherDescription: Try another status — requests are only listed once an employee has applied.

cancelHint: Cancelling an approved leave returns the days to the balance and removes the ON_LEAVE attendance it created.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this approved leave?
cancelDialog.description: {{employee}} keeps the days back in their {{leaveType}} balance, and the ON_LEAVE attendance for those dates is removed. If payroll has already locked the month, the backend will refuse and tell you so.
